title: Honesty
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child gives reasons for telling the truth (Proverbs 12:17, 19) and recognises honest acts.

floor.prerequisite: Knows why we should not steal.
floor.question: Why should we not take others' things?
floor.answer: It is stealing; it is wrong

steps: List reasons to tell the truth.

board.do: Write Proverbs 12:19: truthful lips endure forever.

board.say: Why should we tell the truth?

board.do: Wait for the child to give a reason.

misconceptions.ask: You broke a cup. Should you say the cat did it?
misconceptions.repair: Show how one lie needs another. Praise owning up.

misconceptions.ask: Is copying your friend's homework honest?
misconceptions.repair: Say: the teacher needs to see what you know to help you.

misconceptions.ask: You find a pencil case in the field. What is honest?
misconceptions.repair: Role-play returning it. Ask how the owner feels.

misconceptions.ask: Is a lie wrong if nobody finds out?
misconceptions.repair: Read Proverbs 12:19 and talk about God seeing.

checks.question: Give a reason for telling the truth.
Is copying a friend's work honest?
